text: Stacking implementer branches on an unmerged PR branch breaks under squash-merge: merging main into the stacked branch gives add/add conflicts on every file the base PR added. Fix used: cherry-pick only the issue's own commit onto origin/main under a new branch name (force-push is denied). Prevention: dispatch stacked work only after the base merges, or have the implementer base on a throwaway integration branch and cherry-pick at PR time.

An isolation:worktree subagent that stops with no changes has its worktree auto-removed; a SendMessage resume then runs it in the main checkout. Don't brief implementers to 'stop and report' on a first-step merge failure: either make the first step unable to fail (plain merge, not --ff-only), or re-dispatch fresh rather than resume.

Every parallel M1 PR adds keys to the single assets/deepcharter/lang/en_us.json, so each merge after the first conflicts and needs a hand union plus a re-gate review. Prevention: per-feature lang fragments (lang/parts/<feature>.json) merged into en_us.json by a Gradle processResources step, so no two features touch the same file.

Agent worktree sandbox refused shell commands containing 'git' inside a path (src/main/java/io/github/...), so the implementer had to split and rephrase commands. A sandbox rule that matches 'git' as a command word, not a path substring, would prevent it.

tools/record-evidence.sh rejected its own 9.7 MB GIF at the 5 MB cap (63-frame fly-through, #54), so the implementer rebuilt it by hand with ffmpeg (640 px, 64 colours, no dither). The script should step down size, palette or frame rate itself until the GIF fits.

tools/pr-media.sh run from a subdirectory (build/evidence/<name>/) pushed a pr-media commit that dropped every other PR's folder: git ls-tree <tree-ish> without --full-tree lists only paths under the cwd. Images on merged PRs broke until a manual restore. A cwd-independent script with a 'never drop a folder' pre-push guard prevents it (#106).

Parallel implementers wrote PR bodies to the same shared scratchpad path (body.md), so PR #100 got PR #101's body including 'Closes #54'. Briefs should name a per-PR file inside the agent's worktree, and merge-pr.sh should check that Closes #N matches the branch issue (#106).

GameTest server players default to creative mode, so a damage test on a MockPlayer silently passes no-damage unless it calls setGameMode(SURVIVAL); combined with the unloaded-player and post-dimension-change immunity, three separate traps hide damage in tests. #117 (PR #123) folds the first two into MockPlayers; a survival default or a damage-test helper would fold the third.

Batch-merging two PRs: the orchestrator removed PR #120's worktree (needed because merge-pr.sh's branch delete fails while a worktree has the branch checked out), then merge-pr.sh refused #120 as CONFLICTING because #123 had just merged a change to the same file. The branch survived on origin, but the worktree was gone. Fix: re-check mergeability right before removing a worktree, or let merge-pr.sh tolerate a local branch checked out in a worktree so the worktree can be removed after a successful merge.

Client GameTest waitFor predicates run on the client thread, so computeOnServer inside them throws; #134 hit it and wrote RepairStationClientTest.awaitServer. A shared test/support helper (or README Tests note) would prevent repeats.
Evidence scenarios each copy a record(context, frames) loop (PodDrive, PodCargoFuel, ScannerHud); hoist recordFrames(context, frames, ticksPerFrame) onto EvidenceScenario.

A pod whose chunk unloads and reloads during a client test gets a new entity id (same UUID); tests holding entity ids across ticks in far chunks can break. #76 switched to UUIDs. Consider a test/support lookup by UUID.

tools/record-evidence.sh runs the whole client GameTest suite for one scenario (4-5 min), so any unrelated client test failure blocks the recording; #77's agent trimmed fabric.mod.json temporarily. Filter the client run to the selected scenario.

GameTest helper.spawn takes relative coords but Entity.setPos takes absolute; #76's rock tests passed vacuously until fixed. A test/support helper (e.g. placeAt(helper, rel)) or README Tests note would prevent it.

Run one GameTest: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS='-Dfabric-api.gametest.filter=deepcharter-test:<test_id>' ./gradlew runGameTest (full id or trailing *, not a regex; a bare -D on the gradle line is ignored). Belongs in README Tests; record-evidence.sh could use the client equivalent to run only its scenario.

merge-pr.sh's Closes check matches 'fix #N' anywhere in prose: a PR body saying 'does not fix #139' was refused as closing #139 (#170). Write 'PR 139' in prose, or make the check match only line-start keywords.

Agents share one scratchpad dir and name wrapper scripts the same (gt.sh); one overwrote another's and ran gradle in the wrong worktree. Briefs should require unique names; a repo tools/gametest.sh would remove the need (issue filed).

Overriding isInvulnerableTo to always return true makes a mob immune to /kill and the void (26.3 hurtServer checks it first); a figure that fell out of the world held a spawn slot forever. Prevent: exempt DamageTypeTags.BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY; PR 183 adds a GameTest gate that every deepcharter mob dies to genericKill.

README.md:48 says no PR edits the gametest fabric.mod.json except one line per new evidence scenario, but M2 issues without a stub (#80, #83) must also register their new test class there; implementers flag it every time. Prevent: reword to 'one line per new test class or scenario that has no stub' (fold into the #85 PR).

Client GameTests and evidence recordings hang forever (render thread blocked in SDL_GL_SwapWindow at startup) when the Mac display is asleep; no error, the log just stops after model baking. 'caffeinate -u -t 3' wakes it and 'caffeinate -d -i' keeps it awake. tools/record-evidence.sh and tools/gametest could start caffeinate -d for the run, or the docs should say so.

A reviewer agent ran 'git checkout --detach' in the main checkout while reviewing a PR whose branch lives in a worktree, leaving main's checkout detached. Prevent: reviewer briefs say read-only and never run git checkout/switch/reset in /Users/peterjkeppeler/git/deepcharter; use git show/merge-tree/worktree paths instead.

Client GameTests also hang (render thread blocked in SDL_GL_SwapWindow) when the Mac screen is locked (ioreg CGSSessionScreenIsLocked=Yes), e.g. after the last client JVM exits and the idle lock kicks in; no caffeinate fix applies. Launching with '--graphicsBackend vulkan' (MoltenVK) runs fine on a locked screen: a 15-still scenario took ~70 s. tools/record-evidence.sh could pass that program arg when the screen is locked, or always.

Edit/Write tools rewrite files and drop the exec bit: .githooks/pre-push was committed 100644 twice and git silently ignores a non-executable hook. Prevent with a tool test asserting git ls-files -s mode 100755 for hooks and *.test.sh, or chmod +x after editing.

Pushing to a PR branch right after a close/reopen left GitHub's PR head stale (old sha, CONFLICTING) for minutes; mark-review-passed then pinned the old sha. Prevent: mark-review-passed.sh should compare the PR's headRefOid with git ls-remote of the branch and refuse when they differ, telling you to close+reopen to sync.

The merge gate refuses a PR that embeds pr-media images but carries no-demo (e.g. a docs PR with tryout stills), even though no src/main|client|lang changed; the PR had passed review with no-demo. Prevent: briefs say any PR embedding pr-media media takes the demo label regardless of paths; or the gate's message could suggest it earlier (at mark-review-passed time).
Three agents ran Mac game clients at once despite the check-pgrep-first rule (check-then-start races); a machine-wide client lock (#255) would make it impossible
merge-pr.sh says 'embeds pr-media media' but refuses on a plain pr-media link too; a reviewer and an implementer both read 'embed' literally and kept no-demo (PR 211). Fix the message or the rule

Local shellcheck 0.11.0 passes what CI's older shellcheck flags (SC2015), so pre-push is green and CI red (PR 260). Pin one shellcheck version for both, or have CI install the same version the hook expects

A reviewer testing the client lock ran an unscoped kill -INT $(pgrep -f GradleWrapperMain) that would have hit every agent's Gradle client (it matched nothing only by luck). Briefs say never pkill java; they should say never signal any process you did not start, by PID

Orchestrator merge chaining (wait for 'QUEUE DONE' in a previous waiter's output, then merge the next PR) hung when the first waiter's output was cut short; two waiters for the same PR also raced (one merged, the other saw its own files as a stale base). A single serial merge queue tool (tools/merge-queue.sh <pr>... that merges in order, handles close/reopen and already-merged) would remove both

The #273 deterministic-tour agent ran 14 thirty-minute design-tour runs over 4 h without converging (40-55 of 144 stills still differing) because its brief set a 0-diff target with no iteration cap. Briefs for measure-and-iterate work need a cap (e.g. 3 run pairs) and a 'triage and report' fallback

Subagents share the session scratchpad dir; one agent's generic body.md was overwritten by another's and briefly set as the wrong PR body (#322). Briefs should require PR-unique temp names (pr<N>-body.md), or the PR tooling should take the body from a mktemp file.

Worktree-isolated agents cannot run scripts or read logs in the session scratchpad: the isolation check refuses any command naming that path (its name holds the repo's parent folder name), so helper scripts and logs had to live in the worktree build dir. A scratchpad path the check accepts would prevent it.
